card.name: Digits 5 and 0 inside dose amounts
card.fires_on: The digit 5 (or 0) inside a number in a dose, volume or concentration, usually just before mg, mL or units. Often the digit is the second part of a number such as 25, 50 or 60.

modes.label: Digit 5 in a dose
modes.description: The digit 5 starts or ends a dose or volume figure before a unit.
modes.example: one intramuscular injection of 10 mg/kg (<<5>> mg/lb) every 24

modes.label: Digit 0 after a leading digit
modes.description: A trailing 0 in numbers like 50 or 60 before mg or units.
modes.example: should not exceed 6<<0>> mg/min for phenobarbital sodium
